title: 第2章 惊动十八祖，神子身份，零号序列！
content_zh:
“好吧，连系统都不想让我低调……”君逍遥心里默默吐槽了一句。
“叮，签到地点刷新，请在泰岳古碑签到！”
“泰岳古碑，那是在什么地方？”君逍遥暗想。
不过此事倒是不急，毕竟现在他只是一个婴儿，而且已经签到了一具大成荒古圣体，可以说是完美开局了。
接下来的签到地点，日后再找不迟。
“这次签到得到的是大成荒古圣体，不知道下次签到又会得到什么好东西？”君逍遥心里倒是有些期待。
而这时，君战天却是一拍脑门道：“对了，还没有给我的宝贝孙儿起名字，要不叫他君长生怎么样，寓意他日后要证道长生。”
被抱在怀里的君逍遥有些无语。
君长生这个名字虽然听得过去，但他还是希望能用自己的名字。
“哎，这个不妥，叫长生的人也太多了！”一些族老摇头道。
在这方世界，人人求长生，所以起这个名字人的也格外得多。
这时，一道有些虚弱的声音突然响起：“不如就叫他逍遥吧，夫君曾说过，成仙容易逍遥难，我只希望我的孩儿，日后逍遥一生。”
躺在床榻上，面容苍白的美丽女子开口道。
她正是君逍遥的生母，姜柔。
面对姜柔的建议，君战天等人不能忽略。
因为姜柔的身份也没那么简单，是荒古世家姜家的一位神女。
姜家虽然没有君家那么名声在外，但同样是荒古世家，又能弱到哪里去？
“好，那就叫逍遥了。”君战天点头，只是他好像突然想到了什么心事似的，微微一叹。
君逍遥看到这状况，眼皮一跳。
他这才发现，自己的父亲貌似不在这里。

不会又是那种父亲祭天，法力无边的套路吧？
“战天，莫要忧心，君无悔可是白衣神王，岂会那么容易陨落，而且这孩子日后成长起来，未必不能去寻找帮助他的父亲。”一旁一位老妪出口安慰道。
“也对，哈哈，我还有宝贝孙儿！”君战天恢复了笑容。
君逍遥眼睛眨动，暗暗记下了他父亲的称谓。
白衣神王君无悔。
从这名字看来，自己的父亲，貌似逼格挺高啊……
“逍遥是大成荒古圣体消息传出去，怕是会引起仙域震动，要知道，暗地里想对我君家不利的势力也不少。”一位族老带着深意道。
“你的意思是，动用手段掩盖逍遥身上的圣体波动？”君战天道。
其余族老也是微微点头。
木秀于林，风必摧之。
君逍遥现在可谓是君家的宝，一点差错都不能出现。
“我君家后人，什么时候学会遮遮掩掩了，一具圣体都保护不了吗？”
这时，一道冷哼之声忽然从天穹炸响。
整个君家都是被惊动了，无数道目光投向天帝宫上方。
“那股波动……”
“好强大的气息，是沉眠在祖祠里的老祖宗，从棺材里爬出来了！”
“嘶……连老祖都被惊动了吗？”四面八方传来无数君家人倒吸凉气的声音。
那可是君家的老祖级人物，很多君家人一辈子都无缘见老祖一面。
而君逍遥一生下来，竟然就惊动了老祖，令很多人心头震撼，露出羡慕情绪。
天帝宫内，君战天等族老听到这声音，也是带着震动之色，急忙走出天帝宫。

天帝宫上方虚空，裂开了一道巨大的空间裂缝。
一道有些干瘦的灰衣身影出现。
那是一位灰袍老者，头上，身上，还沾染着尘土，好似刚从地里爬出来。
但他干瘪的身躯里，却仿佛蕴藏着撼世之力！
如同诸天万界，都被他踏在脚下！
“是十八祖，见过十八祖！”
君战天等人急忙躬身。
这位灰袍老者，可是君家真正的老祖级人物，埋在君家祖祠无数年。
唯有君家产生巨大变故，或者到达生死存亡关头时，才会苏醒过来。
君战天等人想都没想到，君逍遥的出生，竟然会引起老祖宗的注意。
十八祖身形一闪，仿佛闪现一般，出现在了君战天身前，将君逍遥抱了过来。
他目光深邃如日月，看向君逍遥。
君逍遥则眨巴着眼睛，不哭不闹，反而带着一丝好奇。
“这是我君家老祖吗，好强大的气息，比爷爷的气息还要强大。”君逍遥心里暗想。
十八祖则是忍不住大笑起来道：“好……好，我君家又出了一头真龙，你们这些蠢东西，竟然还想掩盖这孩子的光芒。”
“十八祖，我是怕日后有人对我孙儿不利……”君战天硬着头皮道。
他们这群族老地位虽高，但在十八祖面前，也只能算是后生晚辈。
“哼，我看谁敢，那些老不死的若是敢拉下脸面对逍遥出手，老夫不介意掀起不朽战，杀他个天翻地覆，血流亿万里！”
十八祖态度霸道无边。
君战天等人都是暗暗咽了一口唾沫。

不朽战，乃是荒古世家，无上皇朝，太古皇族这种等级的不朽道统所掀起的大战。
一战，可让仙域天翻地覆，亿万苍生喋血。
荒天仙域，已经许久没有掀起过不朽战了。
“老夫宣布，以后这孩子就是我君家神子，所有修炼资源向他倾斜，就算硬堆，也得堆出一具大成圣体出来！”十八祖吩咐道。
君战天等族老自是点头认同。
天生打破枷锁的荒古圣体，傻子才会不去培养。
“而且，赐予这孩子，零号序列的资格……”十八祖继续道。
“什么？”众族老震惊。
如果说只是赐予神子身份，那倒也罢了，毕竟只是一个身份地位的象征。
但序列可就不同了。
君家序列，是有资格去争夺家主之位的。
君家年轻一代人数足有数万人。
但获得序列身份的，也仅有十人而已。
也就是说，只有这十人才有资格争夺家主之位。
这十人，每一个拿出去，都可惊艳一个时代，是君家最优秀的十大天骄。
而在十大序列之上，更有一个零号序列。
零，代表一无所有，也代表无限可能！
其地位，还在第一序列之上！
上一代的零号序列，正是君逍遥的父亲，白衣神王君无悔！
“十八祖，这未免有些不妥吧，会让其他序列心生不满……”一位老妪试探道。

每一位序列，都是历经无数考验，才得到这个身份的。
君逍遥一生下来就赐予零号序列，这让其他序列心里怎么想？
“他们不满，让他们日后自己去争，争得过这孩子再说。”十八祖一甩衣袖道。
听其语气，显然对君逍遥极为自信。
君逍遥闻言，默默一叹。
爷爷对他寄予厚望，老祖对他另眼相看，还有自己父亲的隐秘，以及那些君家的隐患。
看来还真是不能当一条咸鱼。
“无敌天赋，无敌背景，系统辅助，有这种完美开局，若还不能镇压一个时代，那只能说我太菜了……”君逍遥暗想道。
content_en:
"Well, even the system doesn't want me to keep a low profile..." Jun Xiaoyao complained silently in his heart.
"Ding, the sign-in location has been refreshed, please sign in at the Taiyue Ancient Monument!"
"Where is the Taiyue Ancient Monument?" Jun Xiaoyao thought to himself.
However, this matter is not urgent. After all, he is just a baby now, and he has already signed a Dachenghuang Ancient Holy Body. It can be said that it is a perfect start.
It’s not too late to find the next check-in location in the future.
"What you got by signing in this time is the Ancient Holy Body of Dachenghuang. I wonder what good things you will get next time you sign in?" Jun Xiaoyao was somewhat looking forward to it.
But at this time, Jun Zhantian slapped his forehead and said, "By the way, I haven't given my precious grandson a name yet. How about calling him Jun Changsheng, which means that he will achieve immortality in the future."
Jun Xiaoyao was speechless as he was held in his arms.
Although the name Jun Changsheng sounded acceptable, he still wanted to use his own name.
"Hey, this is inappropriate, there are too many people called Changsheng!" Some clan elders shook their heads.
In this world, everyone seeks immortality, so there are many people with this name.
At this time, a weak voice suddenly sounded: "Why don't you call him Xiaoyao? My husband once said that it is easy to become an immortal but not easy to be happy. I only hope that my child will live a happy life in the future."
Lying on the bed, the beautiful woman with a pale face spoke.
She is Jun Xiaoyao's biological mother, Jiang Rou.
Facing Jiang Rou's suggestion, Jun Zhantian and others could not ignore it.
Because Jiang Rou's identity is not that simple. She is a goddess from the ancient Jiang family.
Although the Jiang family is not as famous as the Jun family, it is still an ancient family, so how weak can it be?
"Okay, let's call it Xiaoyao." Jun Zhantian nodded, but he seemed to have something on his mind suddenly and sighed slightly.
Jun Xiaoyao's eyelids jumped when he saw this situation.
Only then did he realize that his father seemed not to be here.
Isn't it the kind of routine where father sacrifices to heaven and has boundless magic power again?
"Zhan Tian, ​​don't worry. Jun Wuhui is the God King in White. How can he fall so easily? Moreover, when the child grows up in the future, he may not be able to find his father who helps him." An old woman on the side said comfortingly.
"That's right, haha, I still have a precious grandson!" Jun Zhantian regained his smile.
Jun Xiaoyao blinked and secretly wrote down his father's title.
The white-robed god king has no regrets.
Judging from this name, his father seems to be quite high-ranking...
"If the news that Xiaoyao is the ancient holy body of Dachenghuang spreads out, I'm afraid it will cause a shock in the Immortal Realm. You know, there are many forces that secretly want to be detrimental to my Jun family." A clan elder said with deep meaning.
"You mean to use means to cover up the fluctuations of the holy body on Xiaoyao?" Jun Zhantian said.
The other clan elders also nodded slightly.
Even if the trees are beautiful in the forest, the wind will destroy them.
Jun Xiaoyao can now be said to be the treasure of the Jun family, and nothing can go wrong.
"When did the descendants of my Jun family learn to be secretive? Can't even a holy body protect them?"
At this time, a cold snort suddenly exploded from the sky.
The entire Jun family was alarmed, and countless eyes were cast above the Heavenly Emperor's Palace.
"That wave..."
"What a powerful aura, it's the ancestors who were sleeping in the ancestral temple, crawling out of the coffin!"
"Hiss...have even the ancestors been alarmed?" The sounds of countless Jun family members sucking in cold air came from all directions.
That was an ancestor of the Jun family, and many of the Jun family members never had the opportunity to meet their ancestors.
When Jun Xiaoyao was born, he actually alarmed his ancestors, shocking many people and making them feel envious.
In the Heavenly Emperor's Palace, Jun Zhantian and other clan elders were shocked when they heard this voice and hurriedly walked out of the Heavenly Emperor's Palace.
A huge space crack opened in the void above the Heavenly Emperor's Palace.
A somewhat thin figure in gray clothes appeared.
It was an old man in gray robe, his head and body were still stained withThe dust seemed to have just crawled out of the ground.
But his withered body seemed to contain world-shaking power!
Like all the heavens and worlds, they are all trampled under his feet!
"It's the Eighteenth Ancestor. I've met the Eighteenth Ancestor!"
Jun Zhantian and others hurriedly bowed.
This old man in gray robe is the true ancestor of the Jun family, and he has been buried in the ancestral hall of the Jun family for countless years.
Only when a huge change occurs in the Jun family, or when it reaches a critical moment of life and death, will it wake up.
Jun Zhantian and others never thought that Jun Xiaoyao's birth would attract the attention of their ancestors.
The Eighteenth Patriarch appeared in front of Jun Zhantian in a flash, as if appearing in a flash, and hugged Jun Xiaoyao over.
His eyes were as deep as the sun and moon, looking at Jun Xiaoyao.
Jun Xiaoyao blinked his eyes, not crying or fussing, but with a hint of curiosity.
"Is this the ancestor of my Jun family? Such a powerful aura, even more powerful than grandpa's aura." Jun Xiaoyao thought to himself.
The Eighteenth Ancestor couldn't help laughing and said: "Okay... okay, my Jun family has a real dragon again, you stupid people, you actually want to cover up this child's light."
"Eighteenth Ancestor, I'm afraid that someone will do something bad to my grandson in the future..." Jun Zhantian said bravely.
Although their clan elders have a high status, they can only be regarded as juniors in front of the Eighteenth Ancestor.
"Hmph, let's see who dares. If those old immortals dare to lower their faces and take action against Xiaoyao, I don't mind starting an immortal war and killing him till he is turned upside down and his blood will flow for billions of miles!"
The Eighteenth Patriarch's attitude was extremely domineering.
Jun Zhantian and others swallowed secretly.
The Immortal War is a war started by the immortal orthodoxy of the Ancient Family, the Supreme Dynasty, and the Ancient Royal Family.
One battle could turn the Immortal Realm upside down and cause hundreds of millions of people to bleed.
There has been no immortal war in the Desolate Heaven Immortal Realm for a long time.
"I announce that from now on this child will be the divine son of my Jun family. All cultivation resources will be tilted towards him. Even if they are piled up, a Dacheng Holy Body must be piled up!" the Eighteenth Patriarch ordered.
Jun Zhantian and other clan elders nodded in agreement.
Only a fool would not cultivate the ancient holy body that was born to break the shackles.
"Furthermore, grant this child the qualification for the Zero Sequence..." the Eighteenth Patriarch continued.
"What?" All the elders were shocked.
If it were just to grant the identity of the Son of God, then that would be fine. After all, it was just a symbol of status.
But the sequence is different.
Members of the Jun family are qualified to compete for the position of head of the family.
There are tens of thousands of people in the younger generation of the Jun family.
But there are only ten people who have obtained serial status.
In other words, only these ten people are qualified to compete for the position of head of the family.
Each of these ten people can amaze an era. They are the top ten talents of the Jun family.
And above the top ten sequences, there is a zero sequence.
Zero represents nothing, but also represents infinite possibilities!
Its status is still above the first sequence!
The serial number zero of the previous generation was none other than Jun Xiaoyao’s father, the white-robed god king Jun Wuhui!
"Eighteenth Ancestor, there is something wrong with this. It will make other sequences dissatisfied..." an old woman tried.
Each sequence has gone through countless tests to obtain this identity.
Jun Xiaoyao was given serial number zero when he was born. What did this make other serials think?
"If they are dissatisfied, let them fight on their own in the future until they can win over this child." The Eighteenth Patriarch said with a flick of his sleeves.
Judging from his tone, it was obvious that he was extremely confident in Jun Xiaoyao.
Jun Xiaoyao sighed silently after hearing this.
His grandfather had high hopes for him, his ancestor looked upon him with special eyes, and there were also his father's secrets and the hidden dangers of the Jun family.
It seems that you really can't be a salted fish.
"Invincible talent, invincible background, system assistance, with such a perfect start, if I can't suppress an era, then it can only be said that I am too good..." Jun Xiaoyao thought to himself.
